name: Morimoto Chikako
source:
Minoru’s mother, a housewife. She lives with her son and daughter, since her husband works away from home. She’s gentle, but firm. 

She’s only ever had sex with her husband, but because of his prolonged absence, she’s had to masturbate and watch dirty videos online to take care of her sexual urges, and after her son hypnotizes her, she can’t help the pleasure she feels as she’s corrupted by their immoral acts.
